snippet.title: The Troop - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Troop is a World War 2 turn-based tactics game developed by Giant Flame. Players will control platoons throughout the various theaters of war during World War 2 from D-Day to the Allied Powers fighting against the German counterparts. Engage with 3 different game modes such as Story Mode, Skirmish Mode, and Campaign Mode. The Troop is launching on October 10 for PC.
